body: We can import the `defaultTemplates` like in [ClearRefinements](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/a49c75e5978bb8894ebe8a037b6ea9be8020aa54/src/components/ClearRefinements/__tests__/ClearRefinements-test.tsx)

```suggestion
export type RefinementListComponentTemplates = Required<
  RefinementListOwnTemplates
>
```
The `searchable` templates are available under the `searchBoxTemplateProps` for the component, so it should only take the `RefinementListOwnTemplates`, right?

Also, the type should be in the component, to keep it consistent with other files IMO.
Since this internal type is only used once, I think we can stick to `facetValues?: FacetValue[];`, wdyt?
Is this intentional? (Sorry I don't know our `Rheostat` implementation)
We might want to export this type, like others
(requires test update to capitalize `Home`)
Some of the `!` in this file doesn't seem needed anymore
^ this might be auto-fixed after the master merge?

yes, for the time being there's no checks, so clearly certain things that we mark as optional get defaulted at a certain step, but putting the ! here indicates the possible problem in the future, I didn't want to change code in this pr
the remaining ones don't use prepareTemplateProps now that master is merged :)
it's in the file (same for menu, hierarchical menu, rating menu) because the refinement list component is shared

Open question: wouldn't it be better to have a specific type here. Using the connector type leaks the internal detail this `BreadcrumpProps.items` is the same as `BreadcrumbConnectorParamsItem`, when the widget user doesn't really have to know about it.

Not sure why we need to handle`null` here.  (same for refine)
I know the `BreadcrumbConnectorParamsItem.value` can be`null` but that's true in this PR. 
I don't know in which case is this value reaches actually `null` ?

are we happy using the widget type here?
Currently widgets depends on component, not the other way around.
isn't `'aria-valuenow'` optional? I think casting as unknown hides the fact this value can be undefined but I'm not yet sure how we can avoid that.

There's other components where that's the case. It's true it's a little coupled at the moment, but all components for example rely on the widget for the css classes (instead of the other way round), so we can fix that some other time (add a lint rule to avoid depending too circular), fixing this one instance is insignificant.

```suggestion
        parseFloat((props['aria-valuenow'] as unknown) as (string | undefined)) * 100
```

is this better?
This is the component, so it's not public anyway :) But I import flow this can better be solved globally
parseFloat doesn't accept undefined, so it will be for some other time when we figure out why it even needs to be parsed as a float if it's already a number

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/c57d7bbdd9451299b3af48ce6f894b012c24b9d5/src/connectors/breadcrumb/connectBreadcrumb.ts#L270

this is what makes it null, and I don't see how to avoid it (last item?)
oh right! that's when the value has been selected! 👍  thanks for clarifying.
